data.narrative:
Icarus is a seed-stage company in Defense & Security founded by Henry Kwan. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B valuation), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M). The broader comp universe includes 8 private frontier-tech peers in defense and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. The median valuation across the 3 peers is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This peer-median method produces an implied valuation of $400M for Icarus.

Synthesizing the single applicable method yields a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median of $400M. The analysis is constrained by reliance on a single valuation method with limited peer count; robustness would improve with additional comparable transactions and revenue or profitability multiples. Key uncertainties include Icarus' current funding stage maturity relative to peers, technology differentiation, and customer traction—none of which are quantified in available data. The wide range ($125M–$1.0B) across the peer set signals material variance in how comparable-stage defense firms are being valued.
